title: 第1143章 殉葬者第1142章 未来在何方
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
按照科索的命令，6000人放下武器，走出山区，选择向联盟的士兵投降。
这些士兵眼中含泪，还想留下来和科索一起战死，但科索是这么说的：
“战士们，日月神国的结局已经注定，灭亡已经无法阻挡。
这个政权短暂出现后，唯一的历史任务，就是将我们的世界从愚昧无知的原始部落，拉向大一统的中央奴隶制王朝。
现在这个王朝的历史任务完成了，它已经可以落幕了。
这个王朝把我们兽人带到了新的高度，可因为它成立得过于仓促，内部问题实在太多，它无法根本性的解决我们兽人遇到的综合问题。
现在的毁灭，对我们兽人一族的未来来说，未尝不是一件好事。
大火烧过的森林，土地变得更加肥沃，经过试炼的种子，会在灰烬中成长成更加茁壮的大树。
而你们，就是经过大火历练后的种子！
你们拥有知识，你们拥有文化，你们经历过一个王朝的短暂建立，经历过这个王朝的快速落幕，这是非常难得的经验。
日后若是有机会，你们会建立一个新的王朝。
这个王朝会吸收前者王朝留下的养分，变得更加强壮，这个王朝能解决现有王朝无法解决的问题，让兽人一族走得更远。
而且我希望留下英雄的种子，让英雄能享受后世的和平。
后世兽人一族会遇到很多挑战，会有坏人这么侮辱我们，他们会说真正的英雄全都死在了鹰眼山上，活下来的人都是鼠辈。
我不希望我们的子孙，遭到这样的无端污蔑！
所以你们，我挑选出来的英雄们呐，活下去吧！把你们的英雄血脉传播下去，不要让我们兽人一族，遭到后世小人的无端污蔑！”
就这样，科索身边最后的忠诚武士们，被科索亲自劝退了。
6000人，他们放下武器，走出大山，向联盟投降。
正如科索所说的，这6000人，是真正意义上见识到一个国家成立，并且最终走向毁灭的珍贵人才！
试问这个世界上，有多少人能亲眼看到一个王朝从建立走向毁灭？这种经验是非常宝贵的。

后来这6000人，他们大多半选择跨海，投奔了科索夜，参与了新日月神国的建设。
一部分选择留在联盟，在联盟留下了属于兽人世界的文化，让日月神国达成了文化存续。
众人离开后，科索的表情突然变得严肃。
他身上穿着一套缴获自联盟士兵的凝胶护甲头盔，手里拿着一把自动步枪，弹挂里插满了手榴弹和弹匣。
他对面前留下的2000名猛虎卫武士喊道：
“战士们，你们能留到现在，证明你们已经心存死志。
日月神国虽然短暂，可它到这个世界上后是有意义的，因此这个王朝的落幕，应当有殉葬者，而我们就是殉葬者！
各位殉葬者，既然已经心有死志，那便向敌人发出最后的咆哮吧！
各单位自行进入阵地，把碉堡、战壕、隧道变成吞噬敌人生命的战争机器！
content_en:
Following Corso's orders, 6,000 men laid down their weapons, walked out of the mountains, and chose to surrender to Union soldiers.
These soldiers had tears in their eyes and wanted to stay and die with Corso, but Corso said this:
“Warriors, the fate of the Sun and Moon Kingdom has been doomed, and its destruction is unstoppable.
After this regime briefly emerged, its only historical mission was to transform our world from an ignorant primitive tribe to a unified central slave dynasty.
Now that the historical mission of this dynasty has been completed, it can come to an end.
This dynasty has brought us orcs to a new height, but because it was established too hastily and has too many internal problems, it cannot fundamentally solve the comprehensive problems that we orcs encounter.
The current destruction may not be a bad thing for the future of our orc family.
The forest burned by the fire will make the land more fertile, and the seeds that have passed the test will grow into stronger trees in the ashes.
And you are the seeds that have been tempered by the fire!
You have knowledge, you have culture, and you have experienced the short-lived establishment of a dynasty and the rapid end of this dynasty. This is a very rare experience.
If given the opportunity in the future, you will establish a new dynasty.
This dynasty will absorb the nutrients left by the former dynasty and become stronger. This dynasty can solve problems that the existing dynasty cannot solve, allowing the orcs to go further.
And I hope to leave the seeds of heroes so that heroes can enjoy peace in future generations.
The orcs will encounter many challenges in the future, and some bad guys will insult us like this. They will say that all the real heroes died on Eagle Eye Mountain, and those who survived are all rats.
I don’t want our descendants to suffer such groundless slander!
So you, the heroes I selected, live on! Spread your heroic bloodline and don't let us, the orcs, be slandered by future generations of villains for no reason! "
In this way, the last loyal warriors around Corso were persuaded to retreat by Corso himself.
6,000 people, they laid down their weapons, walked out of the mountains, and surrendered to the Union.
As Corso said, these 6,000 people are precious talents who have truly witnessed the founding of a country and its eventual destruction!
How many people in this world can see a dynasty go from establishment to destruction with their own eyes? This experience is extremely valuable.
Later, most of these 6,000 people chose to cross the sea and defect to Kosoye, and participated in the construction of the new Sun and Moon Kingdom.
Some chose to stay in the Alliance, leaving behind the culture of the orc world in the Alliance, allowing the Sun and Moon Kingdom to achieve cultural survival.
After everyone left, Corso's expression suddenly became serious.
He was wearing a gel armor helmet captured from Union soldiers and was holding an automatic rifle with a magazine full of grenades and magazines.
He shouted to the 2,000 Tiger Guard warriors left in front of him:
"Soldiers, the fact that you can stay until now proves that you are determined to die.
Although the Kingdom of the Sun and Moon is short-lived, it will have meaning after it comes to this world. Therefore, when this dynasty comes to an end, there should be martyrs, and we are the martyrs!
Dear martyrs, since you are already determined to die, let's send your final roar to the enemy!
Each unit enters the position on its own, turning bunkers, trenches, and tunnels into war machines that devour the lives of the enemy!
